decided_by: user 2026-10-12: the Voyager session collects the closed-class words from dictionaries and uses them without further approval

sources.ko: 표준국어대사전(국립국어원) 표제어 — 낱말 자체(표제어)만 쓰고 뜻풀이는 옮기지 않음
sources.en: English dictionary headwords (Merriam-Webster, Oxford Learner's Dictionaries) — headwords only, no definitions copied

scope: closed-class words only. Open-class words (people, objects, places, verbs) are pseudo-words generated anew for every edition (EXAM_DESIGN.md section 2). Articles are left out in v1 (short one-event sentences, similar length in both languages).
numbers_note: Korean uses the native cardinal numerals (수사) placed after the noun, e.g. '공 셋' (grammatical apposition), so each number is one token in both languages.
spatial_note: Korean spatial nouns take the particle 에 after them ('상자 안에'); English prepositions come before the noun ('in box').
ko_particles_note: The allomorph is chosen by the final sound of the preceding (pseudo-)word: a final consonant (받침) takes 이 / 을 / 으로; a final vowel takes 가 / 를 / 로; a final ㄹ takes 로.
